class.name: BaristaScriptResourceLoader
class.brief_description: Loads BaristaScript source text through Godot's resource system.
class.description: The extension installs this format loader at startup. Use [method ResourceLoader.load] to obtain a [BaristaScript]; consumers do not need to create or register a loader themselves. [codeblock lang=gdscript] var extensions := ResourceLoader.get_recognized_extensions_for_type("BaristaScript") assert(extensions.has("barista")) var script := ResourceLoader.load("res://example.barista", "BaristaScript") as BaristaScript if script != null: print(script.source_code) [/codeblock] Recognition accepts a case-insensitive [code].barista[/code] extension and an empty type hint, [code skip-lint]Script[/code], or [code skip-lint]BaristaScript[/code]. The loader reads text through [FileAccess], preserves it in [member Script.source_code], and uses the original resource path when one is supplied by Godot. File-open and read errors propagate to Godot's resource system. Loading does not parse, validate, compile, or execute source. Call [method BaristaScript.is_valid] separately when static validation is needed. Godot controls resource caching; the loader does not implement its own reload policy based on the cache-mode argument. This class adds no script-callable methods or properties of its own. Dependency enumeration, dependency rewriting, resource UIDs, and reporting classes used by a file are not implemented. Do not rely on these hooks for export dependency discovery or source rewriting.
